A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
By a soft answer wrath is turned away, but a bitter word is a cause of angry feelings.
回答柔和，使怒消退；言語暴戾，觸動怒氣。
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
Knowledge is dropping from the tongue of the wise; but from the mouth of the foolish comes a stream of foolish words.
智慧人的舌善發知識；愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
耶和華的眼目無處不在；惡人善人，他都鑒察。
A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
A comforting tongue is a tree of life, but a twisted tongue is a crushing of the spirit.
溫良的舌是生命樹；乖謬的嘴使人心碎。
A fool rejects his father’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction is prudent.
A foolish man puts no value on his father's training; but he who has respect for teaching has good sense.
愚妄人藐視父親的管教；領受責備的，得著見識。
The house of the righteous has great treasure, but the income of the wicked is trouble.
In the house of the upright man there is a great store of wealth; but in the profits of the sinner there is trouble.
義人家中多有財寶；惡人得利反受擾害。
The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the hearts of fools.
The lips of the wise keep knowledge, but the heart of the foolish man is not right.
智慧人的嘴播揚知識；愚昧人的心並不如此。
The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
The offering of the evil-doer is disgusting to the Lord, but the prayer of the upright man is his delight.
惡人獻祭，為耶和華所憎惡；正直人祈禱，為他所喜悅。
The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
The way of the evil-doer is disgusting to the Lord, but he who goes after righteousness is dear to him.
惡人的道路，為耶和華所憎惡；追求公義的，為他所喜愛。
Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
There is bitter punishment for him who is turned from the way; and death will be the fate of the hater of teaching.
捨棄正路的，必受嚴刑；恨惡責備的，必致死亡。
Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD— how much more the hearts of men!
Before the Lord are the underworld and destruction: how much more, then, the hearts of the children of men!
陰間和滅亡尚在耶和華眼前，何況世人的心呢？
A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
The hater of authority has no love for teaching: he will not go to the wise.
褻慢人不愛受責備；他也不就近智慧人。
A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance, but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit.
A glad heart makes a shining face, but by the sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
心中喜樂，面帶笑容；心裡憂愁，靈被損傷。
A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
The heart of the man of good sense goes in search of knowledge, but foolish things are the food of the unwise.
聰明人心求知識；愚昧人口吃愚昧。
All the days of the oppressed are bad, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
All the days of the troubled are evil; but he whose heart is glad has an unending feast.
困苦人的日子都是愁苦；心中歡暢的，常享豐筵。
Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil.
Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, than great wealth together with trouble.
少有財寶，敬畏耶和華，強如多有財寶，煩亂不安。
Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred.
Better is a simple meal where love is, than a fat ox and hate with it.
吃素菜，彼此相愛，強如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger calms dispute.
An angry man makes men come to blows, but he who is slow to get angry puts an end to fighting.
暴怒的人挑啟爭端；忍怒的人止息紛爭。
The way of the slacker is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
Thorns are round the way of the hater of work; but the road of the hard worker becomes a highway.
懶惰人的道像荊棘的籬笆；正直人的路是平坦的大道。
A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish man has no respect for his mother.
智慧子使父親喜樂；愚昧人藐視母親。
Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding walks a straight path.
Foolish behaviour is joy to the unwise; but a man of good sense makes his way straight.
無知的人以愚妄為樂；聰明的人按正直而行。
Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
Where there are no wise suggestions, purposes come to nothing; but by a number of wise guides they are made certain.
不先商議，所謀無效；謀士眾多，所謀乃成。
A man takes joy in a fitting reply— and how good is a timely word!
A man has joy in the answer of his mouth: and a word at the right time, how good it is!
口善應對，自覺喜樂；話合其時，何等美好。
The path of life leads upward for the wise, that he may avoid going down to Sheol.
Acting wisely is the way of life, guiding a man away from the underworld.
智慧人從生命的道上升，使他遠離在下的陰間。
The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but He protects the boundaries of the widow.
The house of the man of pride will be uprooted by the Lord, but he will make safe the heritage of the widow.
耶和華必拆毀驕傲人的家，卻要立定寡婦的地界。
The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the words of the pure are pleasant to Him.
Evil designs are disgusting to the Lord, but the words of the clean-hearted are pleasing.
惡謀為耶和華所憎惡；良言乃為純淨。
He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household, but he who hates bribes will live.
He whose desires are fixed on profit is a cause of trouble to his family; but he who has no desire for offerings will have life.
貪戀財利的，擾害己家；恨惡賄賂的，必得存活。
The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
The heart of the upright gives thought to his answer; but from the mouth of the evil-doer comes a stream of evil things.
義人的心，思量如何回答；惡人的口吐出惡言。
The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
The Lord is far from sinners, but his ear is open to the prayer of the upright.
耶和華遠離惡人，卻聽義人的禱告。
The light of the eyes cheers the heart, and good news nourishes the bones.
The light of the eyes is a joy to the heart, and good news makes the bones fat.
眼有光，使心喜樂；好信息，使骨滋潤。
He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
The man whose ear is open to the teaching of life will have his place among the wise.
聽從生命責備的，必常在智慧人中。
He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.
He who will not be controlled by training has no respect for his soul, but he who gives ear to teaching will get wisdom.
棄絕管教的，輕看自己的生命；聽從責備的，卻得智慧。
The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
The fear of the Lord is the teaching of wisdom; and a low opinion of oneself goes before honour.
敬畏耶和華是智慧的訓誨；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
